#### `BitmapFontRasterizer`

Rasterises an installed system font (or arbitrary `FontFamily`) into a `BitmapFont` by drawing each CP437 byte through `ToUnicode` onto a 1-bit thresholded glyph cell. Lets the user pick any TrueType monospace font on the machine — Consolas, Cascadia Mono, Lucida Console, the Mxoldschool PC fonts if installed, etc. — instead of being limited to the procedurally-generated default.

| `GetInstalledMonospaceFamilies` | `static string[] GetInstalledMonospaceFamilies()` | Returns the names of installed font families, with monospace fonts first. |

#### `FontCodepageWindow`

Modal dialog for choosing a bitmap font + code page + cell grid dimensions when saving to text-mode formats (NFO / ANSI / XBIN). Mirrors the `ReduceColorsWindow` pattern: caller seeds defaults and reads back the user's choices via public properties after `ShowDialog` returns `OK`.

Inherits `Form`. Implements `IBindableComponent`, `IComponent`, `IContainerControl`, `IDisposable`, `IDropTarget`, `ISynchronizeInvoke`, `IWin32Window`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `FontCodepageWindow` | `FontCodepageWindow()` |  |
| `PickedCodepage` | `string PickedCodepage { get; }` | The code page identifier the user picked (e.g. "CP437"). Always set on OK. |
| `PickedColumns` | `int PickedColumns { get; }` |  |
| `PickedFont` | `BitmapFont PickedFont { get; }` | The font the user picked (null until OK). |
| `PickedRows` | `int PickedRows { get; }` |  |
| `SetDefaults` | `void SetDefaults(int columns, int rows, string codepage = null)` | Pre-select the defaults the caller wants (so re-opening the dialog feels sticky). |

#### `ReduceColorsDispatch`

Dispatch for `ReduceColors` using FrameworkExtensions registries. Self-contained — no dependency on Optimizer.Image. Caches generic method delegates per quantizer+ditherer pair.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DithererNames` | `static IEnumerable<string> DithererNames { get; }` | All available ditherer names from FrameworkExtensions registry. |
| `QuantizerNames` | `static IEnumerable<string> QuantizerNames { get; }` | All available quantizer names from FrameworkExtensions registry. |
| `ReduceColors` | `static Bitmap ReduceColors(Bitmap source, string quantizerName, string dithererName, int colorCount, bool isHighQuality = true, Dictionary<string, object> quantizerParams = null, Dictionary<string, object> dithererParams = null)` | Reduce colors of a bitmap using the named quantizer and ditherer from the FrameworkExtensions registry. |

#### `ReduceColorsWindow`

Modal dialog for choosing a quantizer, ditherer, and palette size. Shows a live preview thumbnail of the quantized result. Returns the user's choices as string names so the caller can pass them to any dispatch mechanism.

Inherits `Form`. Implements `IBindableComponent`, `IComponent`, `IContainerControl`, `IDisposable`, `IDropTarget`, `ISynchronizeInvoke`, `IWin32Window`.

| `PaletteSize` | `int PaletteSize { get; }` | The chosen palette size (2..256). |
| `PickedDithererName` | `string PickedDithererName { get; }` | The name of the picked ditherer, or null if none selected. |
| `PickedDithererParams` | `Dictionary<string, object> PickedDithererParams { get; }` | The ditherer parameter overrides chosen by the user, or null if defaults. |

| `ForcePaletteSize` | `void ForcePaletteSize(int size)` | Forces the palette size to a specific value and disables the slider. Useful for monochrome-only formats. |
| `SetAllowedPaletteRanges` | `void SetAllowedPaletteRanges(ValueTuple<int, int>[] ranges)` | Constrains the palette-size slider to the given disjoint ranges (inclusive). Examples: `[(2,2)]` = exactly 2; `[(2,256)]` = up to 256; `[(2,2),(16,16),(256,256)]` = discrete; `[(16,32),(64,96)]` = two ranges. Pass `null` or empty to reset to the default 2..256 range. |
| `SetFixedPalettes` | `void SetFixedPalettes(ValueTuple<string, byte[]>[] palettes)` | Constrains the dialog to choose from a fixed set of pre-defined palettes (e.g. CGA palettes, DOOM palette). Hides the quantizer UI and shows an owner-drawn dropdown of palettes with colour swatches. The ditherer remains user-selectable. Pass `null` or empty to restore normal quantizer mode. If any palette has more entries than the current `SetAllowedPaletteRanges` upper bound, a subset-picker grid is shown so the user can pick which N entries are active (auto-picked from the source image initially, manual override via swatch clicks). Call `SetAllowedPaletteRanges` BEFORE this method when both are needed. |
| `SetMaxPaletteSize` | `void SetMaxPaletteSize(int max)` | Caps the slider's upper limit (and resets the current value to that limit). Useful when the target format supports fewer than 256 colours (e.g. 4-bit indexed = 16). |
